# Purpose

This page demonstrates the PHBern HTML theme: typography, bordeaux accents,
headings, links, tables, callouts, and citations.

::: {.callout-tip title="Best practice"}
Keep the project-wide website address in `_quarto.yml`. Documents exported to
PDF or Word can then link back to the published course site.
:::

## Course materials

- [Free example resource](../resources_free/example-resource.md)
- [Protected example resource](../resources_non_free/example-reading.md)
- [PHBern](https://www.phbern.ch/)

## Structured information

| Deliverable | Recommended format |
|---|---|
| Course page | `phbern-html` |
| Teaching slides | `phbern-revealjs` |
| PDF handout | `phbern-typst` |
| Editable handout | `phbern-docx` |
| Editable slides | `phbern-pptx` |

Multimedia learning depends on design decisions, not on media quantity alone
[@mayer2021].

::: {.callout-note title="Source and automatic elements"}
The [source of this HTML example](https://github.com/PHBern-RConrardy/phbern-is1/blob/main/examples/index.qmd)
uses standard Quarto Markdown. The PHBern visual treatment, table of contents,
and reference list are generated by the format.
:::
